title: REVIEW & LAUNCH
briefing: Two years. One CubeSat. Let's make the plan fit.
I'll keep the bus, power and mass inside their limits.
I'll plan the passes so at least 70% of our data gets home.
I'll choose the imager and plan coverage of Sarawak.
2.5 million, ready in 24 months. We decide together.

nova: A reserve is a plan for surprises.
Let's check what the other departments need.
orion: Weigh it twice. Then write it down.
The battery has to carry the night.
juno: Healthy leaf, dry leaf. That is our question.
A clear target is worth waiting for.
kai: A beautiful image still has to get home.
Clouds above, rain at the dish. We plan for both.

dialogue: aisyah
Now it all has to fit together. Three conflict cards, one team.
nova
We can change the plan. Nobody has to defend a mistake.

beats.objective: Resolve the power and science conflict
dialogue: orion
An instrument can be useful and still need more power than we have.
juno
Let's compare the science gain with the eclipse load.

beats.objective: Resolve the mass and communications conflict
dialogue: kai
More radio capacity can consume our mass margin.
jabu
Fix the clash on paper before it becomes hardware.

beats.objective: Resolve the orbit and science conflict
dialogue: juno
The orbit we want and the orbit we can buy may differ.
aisyah
Find a workable compromise. Check cost and data as well.
nova
Science, safety or cost. Which gets the deciding token?
aisyah
No wrong answer. Just a different mission.
siti
A second imager is a request, not a requirement. Check the whole mission first.

beats.objective: Submit the integrated plan for review
dialogue: aisyah
We check the imager, Sarawak coverage and 70% data return.
aisyah
Then two-year life, budget, mass and the 24-month schedule.
aisyah
If a requirement needs work, we name the problem and revise together.
aisyah
Mission Control? Go, or hold one month to improve the weakest point.
nova
Before launch: power, battery, antenna, instruments, mass, orbit, budget, schedule.
orion
Amber means close to a limit. We read every item.

beats.objective: Confirm the countdown at Mission Control
dialogue: aisyah
Mission Control? All roles, confirm Go.
nova
The countdown begins. Reliability gives us odds, never a promise.
aisyah
Whatever happens, we will learn from it together.
